message.content:
{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study reviews the translational value of animal models of kidney failure, discussing their contribution to clinical translation and prospects for the future. It explicitly mentions that \"Some longstanding animal models have failed to result in therapeutic advances in the clinical setting\" and discusses specific examples like polycystic kidney disease models that \"provided clues for the development of tolvaptan, that was recently approved for the human disease in Japan\". This indicates a quantitative assessment of translation, fitting the inclusion criteria.",
  "arm": "disease-biology",
  "arm_evidence": "We now review animal models reproducing diverse, genetic and acquired, causes of AKI and CKD evolving to kidney failure and discuss the contribution to clinical translation and prospects for the future.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "renal"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Acute kidney injury (AKI) and chronic kidney disease (CKD) are associated with decreased renal function and increased mortality risk, while the therapeutic armamentarium is unsatisfactory.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The review discusses a wide range of animal models for AKI and CKD, including ischemia-reperfusion, toxin-induced models (cisplatin, folic acid, aristolochic acid, glycerol), obstructive AKI (UUO), endotoxic AKI, renal mass reduction, diabetic kidney disease models, hypertension-induced kidney injury, multicause CKD, glomerular injury models, hereditary glomerular injury, PKD models, chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis models, endothelial cell injury models (HUS, preeclampsia), and novel genetic models.",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat",
    "zebrafish",
    "pig",
    "dog",
    "rabbit",
    "non-human-primate"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The text mentions the use of \"Pigs, dogs, rabbits, rats and mice\" for ischemia-reperfusion, \"Mice Rats Zebraﬁsh\" for cisplatin-induced AKI, \"Mice Rats\" for folic acid-induced AKI, \"Mice Rat Rabbits\" for aristolochic acid-induced AKI, \"Mice Rats\" for glycerol-induced AKI, \"Rats and mice\" for endotoxic AKI, \"Rats and mice\" for 5/6 nephrectomy, \"Mice, rats\" for diabetic kidney disease, \"SHR rat\" for hypertension, \"ZSF1 rat\" for multicause CKD, \"rat, mice\" for focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, \"Heymann nephritis rats\" for membranous nephropathy, \"rats\" for IgA nephropathy, \"lpr/lpr mice, (NZBxNZW)F1 mice\" for lupus nephritis, \"mice\" for Alport syndrome, \"mice\" for PKD, \"mice and rats\" for chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis, \"ferrets, newborn pigs, baboon, mice\" for HUS, and \"pregnant rats, dogs, rabbits, sheep and rhesus monkeys\" for preeclampsia.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study discusses both hard outcomes like \"decreased renal function and increased mortality risk\" and \"progression to end-stage renal disease\" as well as biomarkers such as \"albuminuria\", \"serum creatinine\", \"glomerular ﬁltration rate (GFR)\", and \"proteinuria\"."
}
